# v2.37-dev Release Notes

## Performance: the Theatre / Region / Country Comparison report

The performance work continues. The **Theatre / Region / Country Comparison**
report used to download the full training-records and student datasets and build
its comparison matrix and charts in your browser. This release moves that
computation to the server (and caches it), so the browser only downloads the
small, ready-made result.

### What changed

- **Server-side aggregation.** The per-geography matrix (headcount, per-type
  counts, expiring 3/6-month, trainings-per-student), the totals row, and the
  chart are now calculated on the server for the selected comparison level, time
  range, filters and chart mode.
- **Everything looks and behaves the same.** Same numbers, same sortable matrix,
  same charts (by type / function / product, or over time), same time-range
  presets, custom range, and filters. Sorting the table is still instant.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The report's numbers were verified to match the previous version exactly across
  every comparison level, time range, chart mode and filter.
- There's no pagination here — the matrix is one row per geography, which is
  already small; the win is simply not shipping the full dataset to the browser.

### Coming next

The Students list is the last large page still loading everything client-side.
